scripts.deploy:arbitrumSepolia:localOracle: yes | hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/DeployLocalOracle.ts --network arbitrumSepolia --verify --reset --deployment-id arbitrum-sepolia-local-oracle --parameters ignition/parameters.localOracle.json && ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA_ORACLE=local npm run setup-env
